system.description:
Grabbing ahold of your weapon and attaching explosives carefully infused with your chakra allows you to make precise shots tagging their target with explosive force. For the duration, each time you roll an Ammunition Die as part of a Taijutsu attack, you can choose to instead reduce the size of your ammunition die by 1 step. If you do, the affected creature that you deal [Weapon damage] to becomes Ra-Marked until the end of your next turn.

| Neith’s Ammo – Ra Marked / A Creature that is Ra Marked radiates with a soft yellow mist that only the creature that inflicted the mark can see. Once per turn, a Ra Marked creature that takes damage detonates dealing 2d6 Fire damage to all creatures of your choice within 15 feet of it. |
